items: 1 green pepper, chopped to bean size

steps.title: Sauté the vegetables
steps.body: Sauté in olive oil until vegetables are soft: **1 onion**, chopped to bean size, **1 green pepper**, chopped to bean size, and **1–2 cloves garlic**.

steps.title: Add the seasonings
steps.body: Add bay leaf, **1 tsp oregano**, **¼ tsp cumin**, **2 Tbsp red wine vinegar**, **1 tsp honey** and **1 × 15 oz can black beans**, drained.

steps.title: Heat through
steps.body: Heat through and don’t cook too long.
